opening_title: Adding parameterized fixture in pytest_generate_test is not executing the fixture's code, even if it is marked as "indirect"

expected_outcome.rationale: Reports a collection error or unexecuted fixture when injecting usefixtures and indirect parametrization in pytest_generate_tests. #12146 reports an already invoked class fixture executing too often with rebuilt tuples. The opening supplies pytest 8.1.1 and a runnable example but lacks a package list and OS version. Bug versus enhancement is ambiguous because the opening also requests a supported way to add a fixture dynamically.
